title: About PollyGlot
content:
Home
Contact
Privacy Policy
About PollyGlot

PollyGlot is an AI-assisted translation app designed for practical everyday use. The goal is simple: keep translation fast, useful, and easy to trust. Instead of hiding core controls behind complicated workflows, PollyGlot keeps language selection, tone controls, translation history, and speech features visible in one interface.

What the app focuses on

The app supports 20 languages and prioritizes clear output with minimal noise. For short phrases, PollyGlot can offer alternatives so users can choose the wording that best fits context. For non-Latin scripts, pronunciation guidance is included to make output more usable in real conversations. Voice input and text-to-speech are built in for faster hands-free use.

How translation works

PollyGlot sends text to an AI translation service and returns only the translated result. Requests are validated and rate-limited to reduce abuse and keep response quality stable. No account creation is required for basic use, and users can manage local history settings, including save behavior and storage limits, directly in the app.

PollyGlot is built and maintained by Elizabeth Stein.

name: privacy-policy
title: PollyGlot Privacy Policy
content:
Home
About
Contact
Privacy Policy

Last updated: February 10, 2026

Overview

PollyGlot is built to provide translation features with minimal data collection. This page explains what data may be processed, why it is used, and how long it is retained.

Data processed for translation

When you request a translation, the text you submit and selected language settings are sent to the translation API provider in order to generate results. This processing is required to provide core functionality. Translation requests may include temporary metadata such as request time and IP-derived rate-limit counters for abuse protection.

Local storage and settings

PollyGlot stores settings, translation history, and favorites in your browser local storage so your preferences persist between sessions. You can clear this data at any time from your browser or by using in-app controls. Local storage data is not shared with third parties by default.

Security and retention

The service applies input validation and request throttling to reduce abuse risk. Server logs may contain operational error information for debugging and reliability. We aim to keep retained operational data limited to what is necessary for security and uptime.

Contact

For privacy requests, contact privacy@pollyglot.app.
